name: M-Agent (ai-muhammadiyah)
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which default)"):$PATH"; node --version; cd ai-muhammadiyah && npm ci

terminals.name: next-dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which default)"):$PATH"; cd ai-muhammadiyah && npm run dev
